features.name: commerce_offer_pressure
features.description: Weighted, log-scaled blend of offer, action, money, and opt-out indicator columns x016, x024, x020, x023, x007, and x053, scaled to a 0-1 interval with training-fold extrema.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses sparse high-magnitude commercial cues into a smooth axis that can receive a stable linear coefficient.

features.name: direct_address_intensity
features.description: Weighted, log-scaled blend of direct-address, ownership, and message-contact columns x019, x021, x005, x010, and x018.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth personalization axis that helps the linear margin capture tone without relying on any single sparse column.

features.name: institutional_thread_context
features.description: Weighted, log-scaled blend of institutional, project, and thread-context columns x025, x026, x027, x042, x043, x044, x045, x046, and x048.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact contextual axis that a linear model can weight against emphasis-heavy or commercial axes.

features.name: technical_token_context
features.description: Weighted, log-scaled blend of technical, numeric, and lab-like context columns x029, x030, x031, x032, x033, x034, x035, x036, x037, and x041.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes a broad technical vocabulary pattern into one continuous projection suited to linear margins.
features.formula: np.clip((np.log1p(x029) / np.log1p(10.0) + np.log1p(x030) / np.log1p(5.88) + np.log1p(x031) / np.log1p(4.76) + np.log1p(x032) / np.log1p(4.76) + np.log1p(x033) / np.log1p(18.18) + np.log1p(x034) / np.log1p(4.76) + np.log1p(x035) / np.log1p(5.88) + np.log1p(x036) / np.log1p(7.69) + np.log1p(x037) / np.log1p(4.54) + np.log1p(x041) / np.log1p(7.14)) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: symbol_emphasis_intensity
features.description: Weighted, log-scaled blend of punctuation and symbol frequency columns x049, x050, x051, x052, x053, and x054.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures emphasis style as a bounded continuous score, reducing sensitivity to extreme raw symbol frequencies.

features.name: capitalization_run_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled projection of capitalization run statistics x055, x056, and x057 into a single bounded intensity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns highly skewed run-length variables into a smooth severity measure for the SVM margin.

features.name: dominant_capital_run_ratio
features.description: Clipped ratio of the longest capitalization run x056 to total capitalization count x057, with a small stabilizing denominator offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights concentrated capitalization bursts that may be hidden when only aggregate run statistics are used.

features.name: length_adjusted_emphasis_density
features.description: Clipped density of emphasis signals x052, x053, and x056 relative to total capitalization volume x057.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures whether emphasis is unusually concentrated after accounting for overall message scale.

features.name: offer_to_context_balance
features.description: Scaled ratio contrasting commerce and emphasis indicators with institutional and thread-context indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single balance axis that can improve a linear boundary when raw cues appear in competing groups.

features.name: token_presence_breadth
features.description: Fraction of x001 through x048 token-frequency columns that are nonzero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures vocabulary breadth as a linear-friendly sparsity summary beyond individual token frequencies.

features.name: persuasive_style_assessment
features.description: Row-profile semantic score in [0,1]: 0.0 means neutral informational style; 1.0 means strong persuasive pressure style. Assign using only row values, especially x007, x016, x020, x023, x024, x052, x053, and x055-x057, interpreted relative to training-fold ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds expert-style monotone signal for co-occurrence of weak persuasion cues that may be hard for a linear margin to synthesize from raw sparse inputs.

features.name: conversational_context_assessment
features.description: Row-profile semantic score in [0,1]: 0.0 means little work or discussion context; 1.0 means strong institutional, technical, or thread-like context. Assign using only row values, especially x025-x048 and restrained emphasis columns x052, x053, x055, and x056, interpreted relative to training-fold ranges.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a separate interpretable context axis so the linear margin can weight informational style independently of emphasis.
